summary.text: Erika Creydt is the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Michael Shepard in a race with no incumbent.
She serves on the Blaine School District school board.

paragraphs.text: Creydt holds the District 1 seat on the Blaine School District school board, with a term ending in 2027, and previously represented District 3 on that board.
She finished first in the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary, with 44.6 percent of the vote.
